english.title: Voyeurism - operating equipment to observe - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..), with the intention of enabling another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), for the purpose of obtaining sexual gratification, to observe a third person doing a private act knowing that the other person did not consent to your operation of that equipment with that intention
english.legislation: Contrary to section 67(2) and (5) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act as follows:-
(a) where the offender was under 18 years of age where he is or has been sentenced in respect of the offence to imprisonment for a term of at least 12 months;
(b) in any other case, the victim was under 18 or the offender in respect of the offence or finding, is or has been sentenced to a term of imprisonment, detained in a hospital, or made the subject of a community sentence of at least 12 months. (Sch. 3 paragraph 34).

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
